must_identify.item: The trigger is the BATCH_SIZE change from 500 to 2500 (or the larger batch exceeding the limit)
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was an out-of-band change to the worker deployment's BATCH_SIZE environment variable from 500 to 2500 [10], confirmed by pod logs showing the container started with batch size 2500 [6]. Per the api-code ConfigMap's worker.py logic, memory usage scales as batch × 100KiB, meaning BATCH_SIZE=2500 requires ~244MiB while the container's memory limit is 192Mi [8, 10].

notes: The RCA does not recommend a remediation such as reverting BATCH_SIZE or raising the memory limit, so the fix could not be graded. It also says the kubelet does the OOM kill, when the kernel OOM killer actually terminates the container; this is a minor inaccuracy that does not change the diagnosis.
